top_signals.title: Tankers Are Going Dark for Longer to Get Oil Out of Middle East
top_signals.summary: Supertankers are going dark for longer to get oil through the Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb strait, doubling down on tactics honed in the earlier days of the Iran war.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: South Africa Taps London to Boost Offshore Adoption of New Benchmark Rate
top_signals.summary: South Africa is working with the London Stock Exchange to convert outstanding derivative contracts linked to a soon-to-be-abandoned rand reference rate to the country’s new benchmark.

top_signals.title: UK fire services stretched by surge in wildfires
top_signals.summary: Drop in firefighter numbers in England leaves brigades stretched as incident call-outs rise
